# Blythe

[Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college)

## Overview

- **Age:** ten year old (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Blythe has a twin sibling, though the two do not look in the least alike. At ten years old, Blythe's appearance entirely violates the typical tradition of twins.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P15](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0015)_

## History

Known for holding true to their word once given, the Blythe family established a strong presence within their local community over the years. They maintained a close friendship with the Meredith family, frequently visiting [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and providing support and companionship to the children at the manse. Settled at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), the Blythe family home served as a central hub in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), where they warmly welcomed neighbors, hosted discussions on community matters, and offered steadfast defense for their friends during times of local gossip.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), +288 more_
